title: Pipeline
description: A builder/challenger pipeline in .claude/expert-teams/pipelines/<name>.yaml. Each phase is built by its build roles and checked by its review roles.

name.description: Must match the file name without .json.

inputs.description: Files or folders every phase may read.

models.description: A missing entry means opus. sonnet and haiku apply only where they are set explicitly.

humanInTheLoop.description: Who answers consult questions and settles stalemates. autonomous: the agents and the orchestrator settle everything and record their assumptions. as-needed (default): the agents settle everything except the cases in rules.askHumanWhen, which go to the user. always: every consult question and every stalemate goes to the user.

delivery.description: pr-merge: one pull request per phase into the integration branch, merged right away. pr-open: one pull request per phase, a human merges. commit: merge the phase locally, no pull request. The target is integrationBranch, or baseBranch if it is none.

integrationBranch.description: Branch all phases are merged into, created from baseBranch at the first run. Default expert-teams/<name>. When all phases are done, one pull request brings it into baseBranch; a human merges it. none: phases are merged straight into baseBranch.

preCommit.description: Command that must succeed before every commit in code phases, e.g. npm run check. null if there is none.

pushEveryRound.description: Default true: after the build step and after the review step of every round the orchestrator commits the intermediate state with a checkpoint and pushes it to the phase branch, so a crashed run continues from there. Needs a remote. Checkpoint commits skip preCommit; the delivery commit still runs it.

worktrees.description: true: each phase runs in its own git worktree and phases run in parallel. false: phases run one after another in the main directory.

readOnly.description: Paths no agent may change, e.g. the user's inputs.

language.description: Languages of what the agents write, as ISO 639-1 codes. Each defaults to en.

code.description: Source code: identifiers, database tables and columns, API paths and fields, code comments, log messages, test names, commit messages and branch names.

docs.description: Documents: specifications, architecture, decision logs, READMEs.

ui.description: Texts the end users see in the product.

notes.description: Further project rules in plain text, included in every agent task.

askHumanWhen.description: Only for humanInTheLoop as-needed: the cases that go to the user, in plain text, e.g. contradiction with the inputs, change of scope, prices and money amounts.

consult.description: Consult relation: a role pauses on a side question, the orchestrator gets the answer and resumes the role with its full context.

maxPerRound.description: How often one role may pause for questions in one round. Default 3.

agent.description: Name of an agent file in .claude/agents/.

outputs.description: Required for build: the files the role creates.

consultWith.description: Roles the orchestrator asks first when this role has a consult question. Without it the orchestrator picks a fitting role of the pipeline.

from.description: YAML file with the work packages, produced by an earlier phase. Each package has id, type, dependsOn and the files it may change.

code.description: true marks a code phase: rules.preCommit runs before every commit.
